# ECharts vendor asset

`echarts.min.js` is the official Apache ECharts 5.6.0 browser bundle downloaded
from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.6.0/dist/echarts.min.js`.

SHA-256: `bf4a223524e40b77c304bec67e1222cf551f14880cf42c69dc046558e11c07b1`

Keeping the tested version in the repository lets the installed desktop UI render
without reaching a third-party CDN.
